In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Talkeetna Formation represents the best-preserved example of an oceanic-arc section in the world.
the Talkeetna volcanic arc was formed by a subduction process, and the arc rocks are not related to any continental crustal rocks.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Talkeetna section represents an oceanic arc that was formed and erupted for ~7 km of stratigraphic thickness in the Jurassic, but was not accreted to the continental margin.
the Talkeetna Formation was a classic, typical, oceanic arc, but with a few unusual characteristics.
the Talkeetna Formation is a thick section of oceanic arc volcanics that formed in an intra-oceanic arc setting and was subsequently accreted to North America.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Talkeetna Formation is a thick section of oceanic arc volcanic and sedimentary rocks.
the Talkeetna volcanic section, and probably most other volcanic sections of similar size and thickness, are dominated by submarine, mostly mid-oceanic arc volcanics and sedimentation.
the Talkeetna section is the most complete, well-preserved, and well-dated example of a Jurassic intraoceanic volcanic arc section in the world.
